author_scope: Followup metadata only; no proof/code/result changes and no new queries or scientific execution.

observed_R7_DAG.scope: Snapshot while final scientific adoption remained with root/reviewer; not a final delivery count.

evidence_snapshot.final_delivery_receipts: delivery/PUBLICATION_INDEX.json; 9/10 actual stages verified at this metadata snapshot

independent_reference.role: Independent binary64 corroboration; exact production bounds and general proof carry distinct evidence roles.

evidence_snapshot.final_source_HEAD_meaning: S10 full scoped source snapshot, distinct from the subsequent metadata publication head

objective: Bind a real changed native reactive payload or a named conditional/physical consumer to the completed R6/R7 residual and nonlinear-feedback certificates, then implement and validate only the affected adapter or genuinely required new bound.
next_action_order: Read the actual final R7 adoption/delivery record when root publishes it; retain its identity and all completed evidence.
Use a supplied genuinely changed native payload or named consumer input to make one concrete state/pool/source/clock binding.
Construct the exact affected event operator, invariant-compatible initial error and whole-interval coefficient box from that input.
Apply the existing nominal-K R7 certificate when its assumptions bind; otherwise identify and prove only the actual additional collider-K/source/clock term.
Declare a new finite execution contract for the changed dependency before any new computation, preserve originals, and run only the necessary affected checks.

acceptable_next_input_modes.criterion: Original reactive numerical arrays plus an actual named consumer, with native state/spin/observable/domain qualifications retained.
required_payload: Original bytes, immutable provider/source version, exact locator and SHA-256.
Formation and destruction reaction direction, collider charge/isotope, incoming state and outgoing state identifiers including HD(v,j), H2(v,j,ortho/para) as applicable.
Native temperature/collision-energy grid; rate or cross-section units; support/thresholds; any allowed interpolation and extrapolation rules.
State-to-state formation variants and destruction variants, final-state sums and completeness/missingness.
Original spin/symmetry factors and whether each factor is already included; apply exactly once.
Uncertainty/correlation information or explicit unknowns; literal arithmetic does not create a physical uncertainty bound.
Source-matched energies and energy ownership if an energy or Q claim is newly requested.

acceptable_next_input_modes.criterion: A named owner/consumer explicitly declares the finite states, parameter functions/intervals and desired observable for a conditional model.
required_payload: Owner, repository, immutable commit/file and actual consumer function.
Explicit parameter provenance and conditional model scope.
All state/pool/clock/invariant/box inputs required by this contract.
Observable and acceptance tolerance supplied by that consumer.
acceptable_next_input_modes.consequence: May support a new conditional bound/adapter once its new contract is declared. It does not fill missing native GL2022 arrays or silently complete physical source/admission nodes.
acceptable_next_input_modes.prohibited_default: Synthetic R7 controls are not an implicit parameter choice for the consumer.

R4_formation.selection: Select one qualified method variant per physical event; TIQM/SQM are alternatives, not additive rates.

R4_destruction.native_ensemble: H+ + thermal HD(v=0,j=0..8), source spin-weighted H2 product sum

required_map: A common explicitly declared pool/state map for both directions, or an expanded state vector that keeps unmatched pools distinct.
Proof that selected source observables are valid for the consumer's actual incoming population, collider and kinetic temperature.
A declared P and positive lift E(t) with P E=I, including pi(t), piDot or a verified Kpi-piDot bound.
A formation branch alpha distinct from pi, or native per-state formation coefficients that determine it where the total rate is positive.
If total formation is proven identically zero on a whole block, record that exact scope; do not infer zero from absent data or evaluate an undefined branch ratio.
One destruction coefficient d_i for each selected HD state, summed over exactly the declared qualified product channels.
Missing channels remain MISSING_NOT_ZERO; no excitation data substituted for reactive destruction.
source_variant_and_common_pool_binding.detailed_balance: Opposite integer event columns do not alone qualify two native ensemble rates as a microscopic detailed-balance pair.

physical_units.state: physical number density cm^-3 unless an explicit equivalent coordinate is derived
physical_units.time: proper seconds or an exactly specified alternative clock

density_and_clock: Actual nonnegative u=H2, v=D+, w=H+, each selected HD state and each additional collider density/history.
Explicit para/ortho or isotope populations for collider mixtures; an undifferentiated H2 pool does not determine para-H2 density.
Clock map, reference-density normalization and any lapse/scale factor.

If using physical densities in expansion or a changing reference density, include the associated dilution/reference derivative or derive a conserved coordinate before applying closed-reaction invariants.
initial_state: Actual x0 and coarse ybar0 with units and finite bounds.
H/D/charge invariant values and a compatibility check.
For the scalar eta adapter, y-ybar=(-1,-1,1,1)*eta must follow from the same initial invariant class.
If the initial invariant class differs or added source terms leave that subspace, use the general vector comparison or a newly derived expanded error coordinate.
whole_interval_data: Valid positive upper/lower density boxes covering both fine and coarse trajectories and the required convex segments over each complete block.
Native kf/d bounds with actual support and state qualifications.
Explicit branch-distance bound ||alpha-pi||_1 and q_norm bound ||Kpi-piDot||_1.
A lower bound on dbar=d^T pi and any tightened bound on ||Dpi-pi*dbar||_1.
Actual source/coarse mismatch or numerical trajectory defect bound g_e; g_e=0 only when the same exact declared coarse model applies.
Output observable, requested error tolerance and the mapping from R/eta to that observable.
consumer_and_interval_binding.positivity_and_ledger: Selected finite event stoichiometry must preserve the declared W S=0. Full physical positivity and any external source/escape terms must be specified.

required: nonexpansive propagator on kerP within every used block
same H, norm, clock, state order and generator family as the saved certificate
every omitted generator/reset dependence explicitly counted in feedback coefficients
nominal_generator_certificate.R6_reuse: Use the immutable saved R6 native100K para-H2 graph and its exact H/rho pair only after the actual consumer's generator/clock relation is proved.
nominal_generator_certificate.current_source_only_clock: tau=n_coll*(1e-11 cm^3 s^-1)*t; an actual density/history binding is still required.
nominal_generator_certificate.full_interval_requirement: An endpoint coefficient sample is not a whole-block family certificate.
nominal_generator_certificate.state_dependent_collider_K: Requires an additional nonlinear feedback bound relative to a declared nominal K0, or a new valid whole-family propagator certificate. Never silently apply unchanged K-only rho to an unaccounted full operator.

grounded_next_theory_candidate.title: Actual collider-density dependence in the R7 nominal generator binding
activate_only_if: A real named consumer supplies the collider identities, actual density/state dependence and whole-block domain.
The selected native transition coefficients and temperature/state/spin map are supplied or validly inherited.
The changed term prevents direct application of the completed R7 prescribed-nominal-K contract.
A concrete observable/accuracy target and a separate finite execution allowance are declared.

simplest_applicable_case.assumption: K(t,x)=chi(t,x)*K_star with a fixed Markov K_star and a known nonnegative scalar clock factor.
simplest_applicable_case.target: Prove the pathwise operational-clock representation Phi(t,s)=exp(K_star*integral_s^t chi(a,x(a)) da) and certify the integral over each physical block.
simplest_applicable_case.use: Bind an existing native H/rho certificate through that actual integrated clock; rho=1 remains valid if the lower mixing clock vanishes.
simplest_applicable_case.lift_source_requirement: Also bind K(t,x)*pi-piDot over the actual state domain. Fixed pi with K_star*pi=0 removes that Kpi term only under that proved condition; moving/nonstationary lifts retain their actual source and feedback dependence.
simplest_applicable_case.qualification: This is a proposed input-specific binding proof, not an automatic source/density recovery or a claim that all state-dependent generators commute.

bound_targets: b_K >= sup ||J_K*E_lift||_1 for the general coarse norm, or ||J_K*E_lift*s||_1 for the invariant scalar eta coordinate
general_applicable_case.integration_target: Add the verified a_K,b_K,g_K to the existing comparison and preserve the nominal K0 certificate. If P DeltaK=0 holds exactly there is no direct extra coarse fast-source term; otherwise derive that additional projection term explicitly.
general_applicable_case.boundary: These target formulas require whole-domain derivative and source bounds. Existing R7 code/tests do not establish them for an unspecified physical collider law.

grounded_next_theory_candidate.alternative: If a whole state-dependent Markov generator family can be directly enclosed, prove its full-block certificate and count each remaining feedback term once.
grounded_next_theory_candidate.completion_criterion: A proved bound and affected callable adapter for the actual supplied collider law, with targeted independent checks under its new finite contract.
grounded_next_theory_candidate.do_not_create_if_inputs_absent: Keep the precise input dependency and advance another real supplied task; do not create theorem/scaffold nodes merely to raise DAG counts.

R6.scope: Reuse completed proof, interval/core and primary/reference/CAS results without replay.

R7: actual final independent adoption/delivery records when published
immutable_reuse.recovery_policy: Use saved immutable identities and receipts. Narrow integrity recovery only after an actual missing file, identity mismatch or corruption; no routine archive-wide restoration/retesting.

GL2022_status.actual_read: Public HAL metadata returned one main-paper file 214302_1_online.pdf; direct PDF/record access was unavailable or Anubis-denied.
GL2022_status.next_access_trigger: A genuinely new numeric-file locator, original payload, repository version, or concrete access change; do not repeat the same denied challenge/supplement requests.

execution_policy.additional_science: Only an actual changed input/proof obligation under its own explicit finite contract; no automatic allowance renewal.
execution_policy.failure_repair: Preserve first results; a concrete newly observed defect may justify a narrowly scoped changed repair contract, not silent replay.
execution_policy.backups_and_reporting: At each authorized next stage publish/backup the actual artifact and report actual completed/total DAG; final acceptance belongs to root/reviewer.

first_concrete_outputs: One immutable native-source/common-pool binding record or explicitly conditional named-consumer record.
One exact state/spin/variant and density/clock/invariant table.
The actual whole-block coefficient bounds and observable error map.
The affected adapter or a proved additional collider-K term, only where genuinely required.
Targeted results under a new finite contract and actual independent adoption/publication receipts.
